text:
harper (eng-platform): quick bake-off idea: let users toggle 'View: dollars | normalized tokens' on the Cost dashboard. default to tokens for devs, dollars for finance. need to decide what we show for amortized cache savings and shared prefetch.

noah (product): users ask for both constantly. toggle should persist per-user and be query-param friendly so links work. Also want a small "why this mode" tooltip explaining rounding differences.

sophia (eng-ml): two technical notes: 1) token-normalized view should show "effective tokens" = tokens_burn - tokens_saved_est. 2) dollar view requires joining nightly pricing table -> expensive at query time. precompute daily dollars_saved_est instead.

diego (billing): must include dollars for invoice parity. include line items: token_burn, tokens_saved_est, dollars_saved_est, model_sku, routing_reason, canary_percent. For full-tenant exports require billing role. Also want a correction_factor column if derived from sampling.

ira (design): UX idea: small toggle near the sparkline with 2-state label: "Tokens | $". default iconography: token chip vs $ sign. when derived show microcopy "(est.)". don't clutter the card.

harper (eng-platform): implementation sketch: 1) nightly precompute job emits per-tenant-per-route-per-sku daily rows: {date, tenant_id, route_id, sku, token_burn, tokens_saved_est, shared_prefetch_pct, sample_rate, dollars_saved_est, derived_from_sample, correction_factor, routing_reason, canary_percent, primary_tag}. 2) API: /v1/costs/insights?range=1d&view=dollars|tokens returns small aggregated blob. 3) UI: toggle and CSV download. 4) docs: explainer + math appendix.

sophia (eng-ml): we'll compute tokens_saved_est from samples: tokens_saved_est = sampled_tokens_saved * (1/sample_rate). shared_prefetch_pct computed from lineage table and flagged when >10%. we'll add a confidence_interval string for UI.

diego (billing): please ensure dollars_saved_est uses the exact pricing table used for invoices (including sku-discount overrides). auditors will reject otherwise. Also store pricing_version id in the nightly row.

harper (eng-platform): good call. store pricing_version and pricing_snapshot_ts. also add allocation_method field: {proportional_by_hits, owner_by_prefetch}. default to proportional_by_hits, but expose in CSV.

ira (design): microcopy for low-confidence: show amber dot + "Estimated from sample (n=123)" and link to modal with math. For canary split show a small delta pill "Canary +12%" with hover that shows baseline vs canary cost.

sophia (eng-ml): edgecase: quota_reroute. if a request is rerouted because of quota we must set routing_reason=quota_reroute so the dashboard doesn't imply cost savings were voluntary. add a short enum in the API.

harper (eng-platform): agree. we'll include routing_reason in the daily rows and in the small dashboard blob. Also add a concise text field for the tooltip: one of [normal, quota_reroute, region_fallback, manual_override].

diego (billing): CSV columns request: date, tenant_id, route_id, primary_tag, sku, token_burn, tokens_saved_est, shared_prefetch_pct, dollars_saved_est, pricing_version, correction_factor, routing_reason, canary_percent, sample_rate, derived_from_sample, allocation_method. please keep field names stable.

sophia (eng-ml): perf note: avoid computing dollars on the fly. precompute and materialize dollars_saved_est and pricing_version to the daily table. explainer modal can show the formula.

harper (eng-platform): perf note: bundle a tiny "insights_blob" with the dashboard payload to avoid extra hover calls. keep each blob <2KB per visible route. UI should fetch CSV only when user clicks download. rate-limit CSV endpoint.

ira (design): also add a compact icon legend in the modal: token icon, cache icon (small box), routing icons (Q for quota, R for region). will attach mocks.

sophia (eng-ml): testing: I'll provide a DB query and synthetic tenants with varied sample rates to validate confidence intervals. recommend internal beta with billing and a couple of high/low volume tenants.

diego (billing): assign me to beta. we'll validate numbers against ledger exports. also want a 'show raw sampled counts' toggle in CSV to help auditors.

harper (eng-platform): rollout plan: API PR this week, precompute job into staging next, UI toggle + modal + CSV next sprint. internal beta with billing after staging data validated. canary to 10% tenants after 2 weeks if numbers match.

ingest-bot: job started -> cost-insights-precompute v0.1 -> staging. initiated by @harper.

noah (product): one more product ask: add a deep-link to open the modal filtered to a single route/date for disputes. query params should map to the daily row keys.

harper (eng-platform): yep will add deep-link support: /console/costs?route=<id>&date=<YYYY-MM-DD>&view=...

diego (billing): last thing: for prepay customers show normalized tokens only and add a toggle "Show price-equivalent" that maps tokens -> prepay unit. will need pricing snapshot for their contract.

sophia (eng-ml): that's doable if we store contract_pricing_id in nightly rows for prepay tenants. we'll include it when relevant.

harper (eng-platform): thanks team. I'll open the RFC with API schema and sample CSV. drop test tenant names in replies. :thumbsup:
